types.name: CookieCategory
types.doc: One group of cookies a visitor can allow or refuse.

members.name: required
members.doc: Needed for the site to work. Always on and cannot be switched off.

members.name: defaultEnabled
members.doc: Starting position of the switch before a choice is saved. Non-essential categories default to off.

types.name: StoredCookieConsent
types.doc: What is written to storage under `storageKey`.

members.name: openPreferences
members.doc: Opens the preferences panel, for example from a "Cookie settings" footer link.

members.name: closePreferences
members.doc: Closes the preferences panel without saving.

members.name: reset
members.doc: Forgets the saved choice and asks again.

types.name: CookieConsentProps
types.doc: A consent bar that morphs into a preferences panel and, once a choice is saved, folds into a small floating button that reopens it. One surface springs between all three shapes. Non-essential categories start off, refusing is as easy as accepting, and the choice is reported through `onChange` and can be remembered in `localStorage`.

members.name: value
members.doc: The saved choice. `null` means the visitor has not decided yet. Leave it out to let the component manage it.

members.name: onChange
members.type: (value: CookieConsentValue | null, detail: { action: CookieConsentAction; updatedAt: Date }) => void

members.name: storageKey
members.doc: Remembers the choice in `localStorage` under this key. Read it elsewhere with `readCookieConsent`.

members.name: version
members.doc: Bump when your categories or policy change to ask again.

members.name: preferencesOpen
members.doc: Whether the preferences panel is open.

members.name: policy
members.type: { label: string; href?: string; onClick?: () => void }
members.doc: Link to the full policy, shown in the bar and panel.

members.name: strategy
members.doc: `fixed` pins to the viewport; `absolute` fills the nearest positioned ancestor, useful for previews.

members.name: showReopenButton
members.doc: Keep a small button after a choice so visitors can change their mind. Defaults to true.

members.name: reopenSide
members.doc: Corner for the reopen button. Defaults to the bar's side, or left when the bar is centered.
